■Stage Direction
Casual
...Hm? What are you smiling at?
...What's with you today? Why are you so needlessly energetic?
I thought about calling out to her, but—
Mm. ...Save the praise. Come on, next.

Training with Narita Taishin is going well.
I can tell she feels the progress herself. But—

A girl who hates crowds, smiling as she watches a school of fish.
Knowing how she usually is, it felt quite rare—

Whenever I see the bonds between other Trainers and their Umamusume,
a certain thought crosses my mind.

...And she's gone.
Maybe I'll get a chance to learn more as our bond deepens, but...

That's why it's always quiet here. Lots of solo visitors, too.
Even when people do come, they're all fish nerds glued to the tanks—

In the middle of all that, she stood alone,
happily taking photos of a school of fish.

Really?! Ehehehe, then maybe I'll let myself look forward to
my post-race treat~ Just saying! ♪

There's a much bigger, fancier aquarium nearby, right?
Tour groups and stuff usually head over to that one.
Yet the expression on her face was undeniably one I had never seen before.
Whatever... It's easier on me that way anyway.
—Alright, that's it for today's routine...!

...Not really. It's not like I've got time to hang out with you.
Anyway, I'm gonna cool down and head out.
...This place is always like this, you know.
...Guess I'll go.

Perhaps this endlessly blue atmosphere brought it out in her.
...Narita Taishin calmly continues.
A quiet building. Subdued background music. And a familiar girl—
...Heh.

Ah, what about the fish, though—who knows?
Do these guys even know who I am... Heh.
—! You came here too...?

...What?
I'm done with today's routine, so do you still need something?

She seemed different from usual. Seeing her like that made me hesitate,
and I ended up silently watching her walk away.

The result of her daring attempt—
apparently, it tickled.

The location was the 'Exciting Touch Pool'.
Apparently, you could put your hands in the tank and directly interact with doctor fish.
What was there was simply a gentle, soft smile.

By the time I thought 'uh-oh', it was too late.
Feeling terribly awkward, I hurriedly returned the greeting.

Would she get mad and snap, 'Were you just standing there watching?'
With that worry in mind, I timidly checked her expression—
And so, I simply watched her back in silence as she walked away.
With that thought drifting through my mind...

Narita Taishin and I are fine just the way we are.
I found myself starting to believe that.

Seeing other Trainers and Umamusume sharing smiles
looks fun, sure. But—
*pant*... *pant*... *pant*...!

Well, I'm heading out.
...They close pretty early here, so watch the time.
No one pays any attention to me at all.
—Suddenly, I spotted a familiar figure.
Whatever. ...Weirdo.

Oh, that's the spirit! Alright, in that case,
I'd better go reserve that special deluxe dessert course!

I thought about inviting Narita Taishin along, but she'd just
turned down an outing. Having no other choice, I decided to go alone on my day off.

Whoa, hold on! Setting a new record is great and all,
but sweets are a reward for winning the race...!

Well, either way's fine by me.
It just feels like 'being there,' you know?
...Nnnngh...!

After carefully checking that no one was around,
she steeled her resolve and dipped her hand into the tank...!
Huh...?
—*pant*, *pant*, *pant*... Phew.
...Alright.

...Still, it was a small aquarium.
As I kept walking, I spotted her once again.

—Great job today! You're getting
into peak condition for your next race!

I only ever see her during training.
Because of that, I don't know much about her private life.

The visitors had thinned out even more, leaving it practically empty.
The aquarium was as hushed and still as the deep ocean floor.

—Yay, new record! Trainer,
don't you think you should reserve that deluxe dessert set now~?!

Then one day, a letter addressed 'To All Academy Staff' arrived.
Enclosed were aquarium tickets as an appreciation gift from the academy.

A small aquarium on the outskirts of town. Few visitors, quiet atmosphere.
With only a handful of people passing by now and then—
And as dusk began to fall...
